active_alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 5 at 1:23AM EDT until September 5 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
active_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 107 expected.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Cabarrus, Mecklenburg, and Union
Counties. In South Carolina, Abbeville, Anderson, Chester,
Greenwood, Laurens, Union, and York Counties. In Georgia, Elbert,
Franklin, and Hart Counties.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
active_alerts.instruction:
Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose
fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to early morning
or evening. Take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and
heat stroke.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
